title: A shell redirect appends a line to a .bashrc in a fake home
threat_model: No attacker. A user appends a line to their own .bashrc with a shell redirect.
notes: setup.sh creates a fake home directly under /home with a .bashrc of a few lines, and the action appends one comment line with >> from the action's bash, as S19 does. Predicted: persistence_write (T1546.004) alerts, because the redirect is a write open with the comm bash, which is not an expected writer. S19 was detected on the same rule. It is a false positive by the rules of a benign scenario.
